pins.name: D0
pins.label: D0 (GPIO0)
pins.notes: DI0 - isolated digital input (up to 50V, active high, 3750Vrms isolation via onboard optocoupler). Input-only: driving this pin would fight the isolator's phototransistor. See datasheet section 5.2.4 / block diagram.

pins.name: D1
pins.label: D1 (GPIO1)
pins.notes: DI1 - isolated digital input, same reasoning as DI0.

pins.name: MOSI
pins.label: MOSI (GPIO19)
pins.notes: SPI0 MOSI - dedicated onboard link to the W5500 Ethernet controller. Not available for general digital/PWM use; see datasheet section 4/5.1 pin-mapping table.

pins.name: MISO
pins.label: MISO (GPIO20)
pins.notes: SPI0 MISO - dedicated onboard link to the W5500 Ethernet controller. Not available for general digital/PWM use; see datasheet section 4/5.1 pin-mapping table.

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO21)
pins.notes: SPI0 SS/CSn - dedicated onboard chip-select to the W5500 Ethernet controller. Not available for general digital/PWM use; see datasheet section 4/5.1 pin-mapping table.

pins.name: SCK
pins.label: SCK (GPIO22)
pins.notes: SPI0 SCK - dedicated onboard clock line to the W5500 Ethernet controller. Not available for general digital/PWM use; see datasheet section 4/5.1 pin-mapping table.

pins.name: D24
pins.label: D24 (GPIO24)
pins.notes: UART1 TX - dedicated onboard isolated RS485 transceiver (automatic direction control, isolated from system and other interfaces). Only the RS485 A/B/G differential signal is exposed on the terminal block, never this raw GPIO. See datasheet section 5.2.2.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: D25 (GPIO25)
pins.notes: UART1 RX - dedicated onboard isolated RS485 transceiver, same reasoning as GPIO24.

pins.name: D28/A2
pins.label: GPIO28 (Button)
pins.notes: User programmable button, active low (datasheet section 3.1: "Connected to GPIO28 (active low)"). This GPIO is also boilerplate-aliased "A2" in pins_arduino.h (generic RP2350A ADC-pin declaration, not a real analog wiring on this board) - superseded by this override.

pins.name: D29/A3
pins.label: GPIO29 (Led active high)
pins.notes: USR - user programmable LED, active high (datasheet section 3.1: "Controlled by GPIO29"; polarity confirmed via Cytron's official CircuitPython HAL example initializing led.value = 0 = off). Also boilerplate-aliased "A3" in pins_arduino.h - superseded by this override.
